name: letagentsin
description: Agent readiness scanning: score a domain on whether an agent can find, register with and integrate it.

tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Score a domain on agent readiness across five funnel stages. Sixteen points exist on paper; the score is out of the points that both applied to the domain and could be evaluated. Returns a per-check breakdown with the reason for each result and a permanent link.

notes: No account, no key. Five scans per hour per registrable domain, thirty per hour per caller. A scan repeated within fifteen minutes returns the stored result.
